turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about this zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me. I want it withdrawn, Hale, and I want to know who decided.
Of course. Now, who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm not finished, Hale. I asked who decided to enter the zero and whether Owen was heard before it went in, and I still don't have an answer.
Nobody is leaving yet, Hale. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first? I'm waiting for an answer.
END MEETING now, please, I think we should stop.
You can stop once you've answered me, Hale. Who entered the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in? I have until 4:40.
